prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create 6 separate square PNG icons that form ONE consistent set for a figure in a scientific paper. Make one image_gen call per icon.
Style for every icon: clean flat vector illustration, uniform thin dark-grey outlines, soft pastel fills with the accent colour as the main hue, at most one lighter tint for highlights, no gradients, no drop shadows, no texture.
Pure white (#FFFFFF) background, square 1024x1024 canvas, the subject centred with about 12% empty margin on every side. It will be printed 6-9 mm wide, so use bold outlines (about 2.5% of the canvas width), large simple shapes and few small details; it must stay clear at 64x64 px. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI chrome, borders or frames anywhere in the image.
Icons:
(1) zhou_yue.png: head-and-shoulders avatar of a young man with short neat black hair and a calm friendly smile, simple round face with two dot eyes, wearing a plain crew-neck top in the accent colour, no background disc, accent colour #7A8DA8.
(2) lu_ye.png: head-and-shoulders avatar in exactly the same cartoon style and proportions as the first avatar: a young woman with long straight dark-brown hair past the shoulders and a straight fringe, wearing a plain top in the accent colour, no background disc, accent colour #7A8DA8.
(3) li_lei.png: head-and-shoulders avatar in exactly the same cartoon style and proportions as the first avatar: a young man with large round glasses and short tousled brown hair, wearing a plain top in the accent colour, no background disc, accent colour #7A8DA8.
(4) jiang_chen.png: head-and-shoulders avatar in exactly the same cartoon style and proportions as the first avatar: a young woman with a chin-length black bob haircut, wearing a plain top in the accent colour, no background disc, accent colour #7A8DA8.
(5) lin_xi.png: head-and-shoulders avatar in exactly the same cartoon style and proportions as the first avatar: a young woman with dark-brown hair tied in a single high bun on top of the head, wearing a plain top in the accent colour, no background disc, accent colour #7A8DA8.
(6) assistant.png: head-and-shoulders avatar of a friendly chat-assistant robot drawn in the same outline weight as the human avatars: rounded-square head, two large round eyes, a small smile, one short antenna with a ball tip, small round ear pieces, body and head filled in the accent colour with a lighter face plate, accent colour #1F8A8C.
Copy each final image into the current directory with exactly those file names, overwrite nothing else, do not edit the images afterwards, then list the directory.
